Indian + Israeli Couple — Need Some Guidance 🇮🇳🇮🇱
Hi everyone! I’m Indian and my partner is Israeli. We’re planning our future together and I’m trying to understand the practical/legal side of living together in Israel.

For Indian partners in an international relationship, what documents and requirements should we be aware of? Especially regarding:

- Partner/spouse visa or residency process

- Documents I should prepare in India

- Proof of relationship

- Financial requirements

- Police clearance/background checks

- Birth certificate and single-status documents

- Health insurance

- Marriage vs. unmarried-partner options

- Approximate timeline and any common problems to expect

If anyone has gone through the process with an Indian + Israeli couple, I’d really appreciate hearing about your experience and what you wish you had prepared beforehand. 🙏
